description: List the tenant's integrations (type, active state, connect date) — the quick answer to 'what channels are already connected?'. Rows carry a canonical provider key accepted by get_integration_status/start_integration_connect; a null provider means those tools don't manage that integration type (e.g. email or payment plumbing) — don't pass it to them. Existing array shape is preserved. Without limit, returns all rows up to 100 or a PAGING_REQUIRED error. For explicit pages pass limit (1–100) and offset; when a page has limit rows, continue with offset + limit until a shorter page is returned. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token.

limit.description: Explicit page size (1–100). Omit for a complete list up to 100 rows.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; requires limit when nonzero.

name: list_integrations
title: List Integrations
